phone_tablet: Back up your photos, contacts, and personal data to cloud or external storage.
Sign out of all personal accounts (Google, Apple ID, WhatsApp, banking apps).
Perform a full factory reset to securely erase all personal data.
Remove physical SIM card and microSD memory card.
Clean off surface dust and pack with original box or accessories if available.
computer_display: Back up all documents, browser data, and personal files to an external drive or cloud.
Sign out of accounts and securely wipe or format internal storage drives.
For desktop setups or monitors, gather matching power cords and video cables.
Label any known hardware issues (such as faulty keyboard, broken port, or display lines).
charger_cable: Untangle cables and wind them neatly with twist ties or rubber bands.
Check for exposed wiring or fraying and separate damaged cords from working ones.
Bundle matching charging bricks and adapters together with their cables.
small_appliance: Unplug and allow appliances to cool completely before packing.
Clean out all residual food, water tanks, dust bins, or grease.
Bundle removable attachments, power cords, and accessories together.
Note down any known operational defects (such as motor overheating or loose switch).
battery_household: Separate alkaline, button cell, and rechargeable batteries by chemistry.
Apply clear tape over terminals (+ and - ends) of loose batteries to prevent short circuits.
Store loose batteries in a dry, non-conductive container (plastic box or bag).
Never dispose of household batteries in municipal wet or dry waste bins.
battery_lithium: Tape battery terminals or store in non-conductive individual plastic bags.
Inspect for any swelling, punctures, overheating, or chemical leakage.
If a battery is swollen or leaking, place it in sand or a fireproof container and handle with gloves.
Never puncture, crush, or place lithium batteries into general household trash.
clothing_textiles: Wash and thoroughly dry all clothing and textiles prior to donation or drop-off.
Check all pockets thoroughly for cash, IDs, keys, or personal belongings.
Separate gently used wearable clothing from torn, stained, or scrap textiles.
Fold items and pack them into clean, dry bags or cardboard boxes.
books_stationery: Check between book pages for personal bookmarks, notes, cash, or documents.
Separate complete book sets and textbooks by grade or subject.
Test pens and markers; group usable stationery together in pouches or rubber bands.
Wipe covers clean and pack flat in sturdy, dry boxes to prevent spine damage.
furniture: Wipe down surfaces and clean off dust, stains, or upholstery debris.
Disassemble bulky pieces if required and bag all screws, bolts, and small hardware securely.
Check structural stability and note any broken hinges, wobbles, or missing parts.
Ensure drop-off or pickup vehicle clearances and building stairs/elevator access.
household_goods: Thoroughly clean and dry all kitchenware, utensils, decor, or plastic items.
Wrap fragile ceramic, glass, or porcelain items securely in newspaper or padding.
Group complete sets together (such as bowls, cutlery, matching toy sets) in boxes.
Ensure no food residue or moisture remains inside containers.

unsupportedMessages.large_appliance: EcoConnect v1 does not cover large appliances (refrigerators, air conditioners, washing machines). Please contact authorized brand service centers or municipal bulk e-waste pickup.
unsupportedMessages.hazardous: Hazardous materials (chemicals, paints, medicines, lead-acid car batteries) cannot be accepted through regular drop points. Please contact authorized hazardous waste handlers or local civic facilities.
unsupportedMessages.out_of_scope: This item is outside EcoConnect's scope (food waste, construction debris, general garbage, or motor vehicles). Please use your standard municipal waste collection or specialized automotive scrap handlers.
unsupportedMessages.unclear: We couldn't clearly identify this item from your description. Try specifying the item name and whether it is working, repairable, or broken.
